post_topic: Micro SaaS Engine — Buyer's Agent Workflow Product Launch Story
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

Diagram title at top center in bold navy text: "Buyer-Side Workflow — Built for Independent Teams".

Top section: a horizontal left-to-right pipeline flow with four rectangular nodes connected by right-pointing arrows. Node 1 labeled "Showing Booked" — highlighted in blue #5a96ff. Node 2 labeled "Feedback Collected" — navy #0A0F1E. Node 3 labeled "Deal Progressing" — navy #0A0F1E. Node 4 labeled "Closed" — amber #F5A623. Arrows between each node are solid blue #5a96ff lines pointing right.

Below the pipeline flow, a horizontal divider line. Below that, a second section titled "Three Tiers" in navy bold text. Three evenly spaced vertical columns side by side. Left column: box labeled "Solo Agent" with a small checkmark icon. Center column: box labeled "Independent Team" with a highlight border in amber #F5A623 and a small star icon indicating the primary target tier. Right column: box labeled "Brokerage" with a small checkmark icon. All three boxes have navy borders and white backgrounds.

Small label beneath the three-tier section in muted gray text: "14-day money-back guarantee · No sales call required"

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text "Kelvin Davis" bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
